content.title: High-Performance Cloud Native Traffic Authentication Solutions
content.author: Muyang Tian & Zengzeng Yao
content.summary: The session explores using Linux kernel XDP (eBPF) to provide high‑performance, low‑latency traffic authentication for service‑to‑service communication, reducing bottlenecks in cloud‑native environments. It shares real‑world insights from projects like Kmesh, covering performance tuning, security trade‑offs, and integration with broader network security strategies.
content.description: In the rapidly evolving landscape of cloud computing and microservices architecture, efficiently and securely managing communication between services has become a critical challenge. Traditional methods of network traffic authentication often become a performance bottleneck, especially when handling large-scale data flows.
